01-minimal-monochrome.title: 2027 Printable Calendar, Minimalist Monthly Calendar, A4 & US Letter, Sunday & Monday Start, Portrait & Landscape, Simple Wall Calendar PDF

Keep 2027 simple. A clean, minimalist monthly calendar that prints beautifully on any home printer and uses very little ink.

You get every version in one purchase, so you never have to guess which file you need: A4 and US Letter, portrait and landscape, Sunday start and Monday start.

• 8 PDF files (2 ZIP folders: A4 + US Letter)
• Each file has 14 pages: cover, year at a glance, January to December
• Portrait pages include a lined notes section under each month
